title: THE GUEST WHOSE HELLO WAS OUR GOODBYE
author: CLAUDE

final_critic_line: Visitors whose time runs backward greeted a Norrow graveside with what looked like a farewell and hurt anyone who reached for them; Illuminara read the greeting by reversing the clinic recording, owned a failed test that frightened a mourner, and let a grandfather's carved name-stone become the one act that reads the same in both directions, so a mother buried her child by the sea and the town kept a lamp rule instead of a seal.
